title: 第11章 白莲花第12章 体修
content_zh:
在此之后杨威便联系了周法将丹药全部卖给了水司寨总价值一千二百灵石，除去成本以及两成税款获利八百灵石
寨子毕竟是与官家合作的势力税法正常，杨威也是正常遵守制度并未多言
此后杨威再次安静进入修行，有时还会外出查探情况
马上就要进入深冬，水路上的兽潮比之陆路要凶险的多，一般都是比房子还大的大型肉食鱼妖
据说其中不乏二阶妖兽出没，甚至有人看到了金丹级的三阶妖兽血鲸出现
以杨威目前的实力对付一阶都困难，所以只能暂时打消了冬季出行，等到来年初春再说了。
一个月后
巨船六层靠墙的房屋内，一圈圈火光环绕少年身前，随着时间推给一点点的壮大着他的法力强度
当杨威再次睁开眼睛之时已是炼气五重成
中间许文树拜访过他一次将所欠灵石还了，不仅如此还多给了两枚当做利息
杨威知道姐弟俩情况拮据自然不会多收，不过他并非将灵石奉还而是送了对方一颗中品养元丹
不仅巧妙的再次送出了人情，还从他那里打听到了一些消息
原来其姐许英杰本来也要一起来的，只是中途接到任务要去追捕魔头
据说此獠在水寨周边地区祸害已久，十几天前这魔头潜入鹿城大肆杀戮官家驻守修士几乎被全歼了
随后这魔头又潜入距离鹿城最近的福临城一通乱杀，甚至就连凡人也不放过一夜之间屠杀了数百人泄愤直到附近筑基修士赶到才将其吓走
此事震惊了整个大赵官家，那边立即便派遣人手前去镇压，距离不过百里的司水寨便是其中之一
杨威不禁暗暗扎舌这魔修还真是死咬着他不放了
在送走了徐文树后，他立即便拿出六神珠查看，其上的隔绝封印依旧完好，除了几道因时间消散的外一切正常
再结合之前魔修的种种行径说明如今对方已经不能够精准的定位了
如此杨威也能稍稍安心同时对这魔头的实力又有了些新的认识

估摸对方大约是在筑基左右应该还没到筑基
竟敢如此疯狂的惹怒官家想必一定还有其他手段自己也不可掉以轻心
他只需时刻密切关注着此事情况一有不对便打算带着翠翠跑路
当然这也是最坏的打算，水司寨好歹也有两名筑基坐镇，一个是寨主白逸群一个是族中长老白云，两人的修为也分别在筑基中期和筑基初期
哪怕这魔修打上门来有了这二位抵挡杨威想要逃走还是很简单的
至于是否归还宝物平息魔修怒火，杨威从来没有考虑过这条选项
哪怕他现在将六神珠物归原主，对方也不会放他一条生路，魔修之所以是魔修就是其修行路数邪门行事乖张
况且杨威也并不惧怕，他只是比较谨慎罢了，等到他修为达到高段之时也不用担心那魔修了
本着三十六计走为上，能当老六绝不当老八的原则，他也不会去主动招惹对方静待其变。
如今又有半个月没有听到那边传来动静，说不定便是魔修已经离开或是被某位筑基修士斩杀了
杨威的目光看向打坐在不远处的翠翠，妮子果然有些悟性接触修行不到两月便已成功入道了
对于拥有的水木双灵根的她来说这水司寨无疑是个很好的修行地点，有着灵泉水性灵气充裕
当然翠翠这般新人能有这番成绩也与杨威的悉心密不可分
“威哥，看着我干嘛？
如今开了灵识翠翠闭着眼睛也能感知到屋内的情况，发现动静后便睁眼笑道
“抱元守一，心无旁骛，聚气凝神，运转周天”
杨威没有与她嘻嘻哈哈而是较为严肃的教导着
因为他深知在修行上对翠翠放松便是在害她
虽说其有着双灵根却不代表着一定能够筑基
前世杨威见过太多前期天赋惊人最后却因为拖延懒惰百年不到便化作一堆枯骨的例子
content_en:
After that, Yang Wei contacted Zhou Fa and sold all the elixirs to Shuisizhai with a total value of 1,200 spirit stones, excluding the cost and 20% of the tax, making a profit of 800 spirit stones.
After all, Zhaizi is a force cooperating with the government. Tax laws are normal, and Yang Wei also abides by the system normally and does not say much.
After that, Yang Wei quietly entered into practice again, and sometimes went out to investigate the situation.
It is about to enter the depth of winter, and the tide of beasts on the waterway is much more dangerous than on the land. They are usually large carnivorous fish monsters that are bigger than a house.
It is said that there are many second-order monsters among them, and some people even saw the appearance of the third-order monster Blood Whale at the Golden Core level.
It is difficult for Yang Wei to deal with the first level with his current strength, so he can only temporarily cancel his winter travel and wait until early spring.
a month later
In the house on the sixth floor of the giant ship, which was against the wall, circles of fire surrounded the young man. As time went by, the strength of his magic power increased little by little.
When Yang Wei opened his eyes again, he was already at the fifth level of Qi refining.
Xu Wenshu visited him once and paid him back the spiritual stones he owed. Not only that, he also gave him two more as interest.
Yang Wei knew that the brother and sister were in a tight situation, so he would not charge more, but instead of returning the spirit stone, he gave the other party a middle-grade Yuan Yang Dan.
Not only did he cleverly extend the favor again, but he also got some news from him.
It turns out that his sister Xu Yingjie was also going to come with her, but she got a mission to hunt down the devil.
It is said that this beast has been causing harm to the area around Shuizhai for a long time. A dozen days ago, this demon sneaked into Lucheng and massacred the official monks stationed there, and was almost wiped out.
Then the devil sneaked into Fulin City, which was closest to Lucheng, and started killing indiscriminately. Even mortals were not spared, and he massacred hundreds of people overnight to vent his anger. It was not until the nearby foundation-building monks arrived that they scared him away.
This incident shocked the entire Da Zhao official family, who immediately dispatched personnel to suppress it. Sishui Village, which was only a hundred miles away, was one of them.
Yang Wei couldn't help but secretly stabbed his tongue. This demonic cultivator was really biting him and wouldn't let him go.
After sending Xu Wenshu away, he immediately took out the Six God Pearl and checked it. The isolation seal on it was still intact, and everything was normal except for a few that had dissipated due to time.
Combined with the various behaviors of the previous demon cultivators, it shows that the opponent is no longer able to accurately locate
In this way, Yang Wei could feel a little more at ease and gain some new understanding of the demon's strength.
I estimate that the other party is around the time of foundation building and probably hasn't reached foundation building yet.
How dare you anger the officials so crazily? You must have other means, and you shouldn't take it lightly.
He only needs to pay close attention to the situation at all times and plan to run away with Cuicui if something goes wrong.
Of course, this is also the worst plan. After all, there are two foundation builders in Shui Sizhai. One is the village leader Bai Yiqun and the other is the clan elder Baiyun. Their cultivation levels are also in the middle and early stages of foundation building respectively.
Even if the demonic cultivator comes knocking on the door, with these two people, it is still very easy to resist Yang Wei and escape.
As for whether to return the treasure to calm the anger of the demon cultivator, Yang Wei has never considered this option.
Even if he returns the Six Gods Pearl to its original owner now, the other party will not let him live. The reason why a demon cultivator is a demon cultivator is that his practice is evil and his behavior is erratic.
Besides, Yang Wei is not afraid, he is just more cautious. When his cultivation reaches a high level, he won't have to worry about the demon cultivator.
In line with the principle of Thirty-Six Strategies, and the principle of being the sixth and never the eighth, he will not take the initiative to provoke the other party and wait for it to change.
Now I haven't heard any movement from there for another half month. Maybe the demon cultivator has left or been killed by a foundation-building cultivator.
Yang Wei looked at Cuicui who was meditating not far away. Sure enough, Nizi had some understanding and had successfully entered Taoism in less than two months.
For her who possesses the dual spiritual roots of water and wood, this Shui Sizhai is undoubtedly a good place to practice, with its spiritual springs and abundant water-based spiritual energy.
Of course, the achievements of a newcomer like Cuicui are inseparable from Yang Wei's carefulness.
"Brother Wei, why are you looking at me?
Now that the spiritual consciousness is open and Cuicui is closed,The eyes can also sense the situation in the house. When they notice any movement, they open their eyes and smile.
"Hold Yuan Shouyi, have no distractions, gather energy and concentrate, and move the heavens around."
Yang Wei did not joke with her but taught her more seriously.
Because he knew very well that relaxing on Cuicui in practice would be harming her.
Although it has dual spiritual roots, it does not mean that it will definitely be able to build a foundation.
In his previous life, Yang Wei had seen too many examples of people who had amazing talents in the early stage but ended up being reduced to a pile of withered bones within a hundred years due to procrastination and laziness.
